items.title: Carol Bash interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2012
items.q: I have met Ken Burns, and I have met his brother, Rick Burns.

ctx.x: Have you met him? You know I was going to say, is it an oxymoron to say that there’s such a thing as a well-to-do documentary filmmaker? Maybe he’s the one.
You know look, between Ken Burns and Michael Moore, God bless them.
